skills-library.description: Searches a local library of skills and agents and manages their installation into coding harnesses.

toolshed.description: Standalone registry and proxy for local agent capabilities: skills, agents, commands, and MCP servers across machine corpora.

orchestrator.description: MCP server over a git repository and its local task board for autonomous agent mission planning.

verifier.description: MCP server that runs project checks and test suites, durably recording the results.

content-creation.description: Harness-agnostic MCP server exposing content-creation skills and agents across video, audio, 3D, design, and text.

playwright.description: Browser automation and testing via Playwright for visual inspection, screenshots, and page navigation.

chrome-devtools.description: Chrome/Brave DevTools protocol integration for console logs, network tracing, and DOM inspections.

memory.description: Persistent graph-based memory across sessions with entities, relations, and observations.

sequential-thinking.description: Dynamic step-by-step reasoning tool enabling structured decomposition of complex problems.

squish.description: Local-first persistent memory runtime for AI agents with 1-20ms SQLite recall.

token-optimizer.description: Token optimization for 95%+ context reduction via content deduplication and compression.

omega-memory.description: Persistent agent memory with semantic search, multi-agent coordination, and knowledge graphs.

longhand.description: Lossless session history indexer capturing tool calls, edits, and thinking blocks into local SQLite + ChromaDB.

evalview.description: AI agent regression testing suite detecting regressions in tool calls and output quality.

devfleet.description: Multi-agent parallel orchestration daemon dispatching parallel agents in isolated worktrees.
